A dental implant is a small screw made of titanium or ceramic that is inserted into the jawbone in place of the tooth root. Where there is too little bone, grafting has to be done first, which extends the schedule by months. Where stability is sufficient, a temporary restoration can be fitted immediately in certain cases; that does not mean the implant can be loaded any sooner.
